The '''Refinery District''' was the northern section of the [[Black Hole (Corellia)|Black Hole]], a region of the [[Labor Valley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. The Refinery District was north of the [[Administration District]] and was where most of the [[Hypermatter/Legends|hypermatter]] refineries in the area were located. During the [[battle for the Black Hole]] in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Corellia]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] maintained a foothold at [[Sentinel Outpost]] as they battled the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Coronas]] gang for control of the region.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Refinery District appears as a subzone of the Black Hole Daily Area in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''; the Black Hole was added to the game in Game Update 1.2: Legacy on [[April 12]], [[2012]].<ref name="1.2">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/1.2.0/legacy|text=Game Update 1.2: Legacy Patch Notes}}</ref>
